name: Favela Relay
description: A relay hut on the top of Rio's hill talks to the Antarctic base, and the favela below is the gang's. Climb three terraces by their stairwells to the roof of the hill. On every terrace the street is for the soldier, who shoots through the gang's gunmen and their barricades, and the rooftops are for the hacker, who crosses them with USB keys, laser switches and the goggles for the hidden planks. The relay's password opens the way south.
